title: Kandy — preparation of new development plan / city profile
scope: Planning profile: city population 130,000, transient 160,000/day, employment 90,000/day, education 60,000/day, tourists/pilgrims 6,000/day, commuter population 600,000/day
limitations: Planning figures have heterogeneous definitions and an unclear reference year; not a statistical agglomeration definition.

title: Kandy Development Plan 2019–2030
scope: Land use, congestion, heritage constraints and planning-era land values; LKR 0.5m–6m per perch within city
limitations: Planning document; land-value range is not a current transaction index and its valuation method is not specified.

title: Sacred City of Kandy
scope: World Heritage status, last royal capital and Temple of the Tooth pilgrimage function
limitations: Heritage-status and significance source, not evidence by itself for economic causality.

title: Challenges for urban conservation of core area in pilgrim cities of India
scope: Comparative evidence that pilgrimage cities sustain large floating populations and face built-environment/conservation pressures linked to sacred cores
limitations: Indian pilgrim-city comparison; supports transport of a pilgrimage/urban-pressure mechanism only, not Kandy-specific outcomes or economic success.
